attempts.text:
ASHISH SHARMA 

Senior Technical Documentation Engineer 

South Delhi, India | +91 7905878113 | ashuguru54@gmail.com 

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY: - 

Results-driven Senior Technical Documentation Engineer with 6+ years of experience in 

technical documentation, engineering documentation management, project documentation, 

validation documentation, technical submittals, compliance documentation, and client 

coordination. 

CORE COMPETENCIES: - 

Technical Documentation, Engineering Documentation, Technical Submittals, Method 

Statements, SOP Development, User Manuals, Validation Documentation (DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ), 

Project Handover Documentation, Compliance Documentation, Document Control, Material 

Submittals, Vendor Documentation, BMS & EMS Documentation, Technical Specifications, 

Client Coordination, MS Word, MS Excel, PowerPoint. 

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE: -  

1. Koncept Engineers | Jul 2024 – Present 

Senior Technical Documentation Engineer  

 

• Technical Documentation Management – Prepare, review, and maintain engineering 

documents, technical specifications, SOPs, manuals, and project documentation. 

 

• Technical Submittals – Develop and submit material submittals, datasheets, 

catalogues, test certificates, and compliance documents. 

 

• Validation Documentation – Prepare and manage DQ, IQ, OQ, and PQ protocols and 

reports. 

 

• Document Control – Maintain document lifecycle, revision history, version control, and 

tracking systems. 

 

• Compliance Management – Ensure documentation compliance with project 

specifications and quality standards. 

 

• Project Documentation – Prepare method statements, technical compliance reports, 

and project handover dossiers. 

 



• Engineering Coordination – Coordinate with engineering, procurement, project, and 

quality teams. 

 

• BMS & EMS Documentation – Manage system documentation throughout project 

execution. 

 

• Drawing & Vendor Review – Review technical drawings, vendor documents, and 

specifications. 

 

• Billing Documentation – Support preparation of RA Bills and BOQ documentation. 

 

• Client Management – Coordinate submissions, approvals, and project close-outs. 

 

• Process Improvement – Standardize documentation templates and workflows. 

 

 2. Anankand Paramount Products Pvt. Ltd. (SMC Corporation India)  

     Jul 2019 – Jun 2024 (Technical Documentation Engineer) 
 

• Technical Documentation – Prepared technical documents, quotations, proposals, and 

product information sheets. 

 

• Customer Support – Provided technical assistance and documentation support. 

 

• Client Communication – Managed technical and commercial communications. 

 

• Documentation Control – Organized and maintained business records and technical 

documents. 

 

• Relationship Management – Built strong customer relationships through timely 

support. 

EDUCATIONAL QULIFICATIONS: - 

• B. Tech, Mechanical Engineering – JB Knowledge Park, Faridabad (2017) 

 

• Intermediate (12th) – SVN Inter College, Sultanpur, Uttar Pradesh (2013) 

 

• High School (10th) – Radhiant Inter College, Jalalpur, Uttar Pradesh (2011) 

TRAINING & CERTIFICATIONS: - 

Industrial Training – KS Oils Ltd., Guna (M.P.) – 6-week training in oil refining processes. 
AutoCAD Training – DUCAT, JB Knowledge Park
